name: The Parted Arch
description: A rounded threshold with two suspended, tapering veils and an open base.

name: The Lifted Veil
description: A single diagonal sweep opens an otherwise quiet architectural frame.

name: The Lancet
description: A pointed stone arch with two long, fine inner veil edges.

name: The Double Threshold
description: An enclosing oval with two opposing apertures; an orientation-neutral architectural seal.

name: The Receding Arch
description: Two unequal archways joined by a shallow step, suggesting passage and depth.

name: The Twin Gates
description: Two interleaved archways at different heights create a measured, asymmetric rhythm.

name: The Quiet Opening
description: A slightly weighted, off-centre aperture with one fine veil slipping into the margin.

name: The Turning Aperture
description: Two nested elliptic turns with open ends, like a folded edge caught in rotation.
